== Exceptions.tryCatch (line 2)
| tryCatch(s)
  try
    | e
    -
      jump
        | return Integer.parseInt(s)
    -
      jump
        | return 0
    -

== Exceptions.multiCatch (line 8)
| multiCatch(r)
  try
    | exception
    -
      instruction
        | r.read()
    -
      case
        | exception instanceof?
        | IOException
        | RuntimeException
        | %
        -
          instruction
            | e := exception
          call
            | log(e)
        -
          instruction
            | e := exception
          call
            | log(e)
        -
    -

== Exceptions.unionCatch (line 16)
| unionCatch(r)
  try
    | e
    -
      instruction
        | r.read()
    -
      case
        | e instanceof?
        | IOException, RuntimeException
        | %
        -
          call
            | log(e)
        -
    -

== Exceptions.tryFinally (line 22)
| tryFinally(r)
  try
    | e
    -
      instruction
        | r.read()
    -
      call
        | log(e)
    -
      instruction
        | r.close()

== Exceptions.onlyFinally (line 30)
| onlyFinally(r)
  try
    -
      instruction
        | r.read()
    -
    -
      instruction
        | r.close()

== Exceptions.log (line 36)
| log(e)
